control_profile: Deterministic fifty-eight-percent gross exposure with common-market residualization, robust clipping, relative-rank admission, and symmetric long/short sizing; organizer stops, cooldowns, drawdown brakes, time stops, turnover clipping, and volatility targeting are disabled.
falsifier: Reject broader role-specific persistence if either sleeve is non-positive, diversification dilutes edge below fifty basis points, any post-warmup era is structurally weak, or the combined portfolio cannot survive stressed costs.
formation_horizon: longs use seventy-eight completed weekly observations with a thirty-nine-week minimum; shorts use one hundred four completed weekly observations with a fifty-two-week minimum; both use Monday 00:00, 08:00, and 16:00 UTC anchors
hypothesis: The role-specific Monday ranking has excess edge but insufficient temporal breadth at eight names per sleeve; selecting thirty-five percent of each valid cross-section should test the upper edge of the diversification plateau while preserving positive long and short edge.
rebalance_horizon: weekly Monday 08:00 UTC direct rebalance with continuous twenty-one-bar holding between decisions
